#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
const LL mod = 1e9 + 7;

LL modpow(LL a, LL b) {
    LL res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<vector<int>> p(n + 1, vector<int>(n + 1));
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            cin >> p[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    // For n <= 6, we can use brute force over all permutations
    // A perfect matching exists iff there's a permutation pi such that
    // edge (i, pi[i]) exists for all i
    // Probability = sum over all permutations of product of p[i][pi[i]]/100
    
    vector<int> perm(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) perm[i] = i;
    
    LL total = 0;
    do {
        LL prob = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            prob = prob * p[i + 1][perm[i] + 1] % mod;
        }
        total = (total + prob) % mod;
    } while (next_permutation(perm.begin(), perm.end()));
    
    // Divide by 100^n
    LL inv100 = modpow(100, mod - 2);
    LL inv100n = modpow(inv100, n);
    total = total * inv100n % mod;
    
    cout << total << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
